brief: Plan the soft launch of Acme's invoice reminder app to the first 50 small agencies on our waitlist, starting in three weeks.
intake:
# Acme

Acme makes a web app that sends polite payment reminders for unpaid invoices.

- Customer: small design and marketing agencies, 2 to 15 people, that invoice clients monthly.
- Problem: owners chase late invoices by hand and avoid it because it feels awkward.
- Stage: private beta with 8 agencies; 120 people on the waitlist from a landing page.
- Price: planned at 19 per month, not yet charged.
- Team: one founder and one part-time developer. Budget for the launch: 500.

brief: Plan the launch of Acme's new client portal feature to existing customers next month.
intake:
# Acme

Acme sells scheduling software to independent physiotherapy clinics.

- Customers: 140 paying clinics, mostly 1 to 4 therapists each.
- New feature: a client portal where patients book, move and cancel their own sessions.
- Evidence: 30 support requests a month ask for self-booking; two clinics left for a rival that has it.
- Price: included in the current plan; no extra charge.
- Team: four people; one handles support and the newsletter (1,900 subscribers).

brief: Plan a loud launch for Acme's meal-prep subscription in one new city, opening in six weeks.
intake:
# Acme

Acme delivers weekly meal-prep boxes for busy parents.

- Today: 600 subscribers in its first city after one year, 9% monthly churn.
- New city: about 2 hours away; kitchen partner signed, no customers yet.
- Channels that worked: school parent groups and referral codes (a third of sign-ups).
- Price: 79 per week for a family box.
- Team: two founders, one ops lead. Launch budget: 6,000.

brief: Plan the launch of Acme's first paid plan to current free users, switching on billing in four weeks.
intake:
# Acme

Acme makes a habit tracker app for freelancers.

- Users: 3,400 free accounts, 900 active weekly.
- Paid plan: 6 per month for sync across devices and yearly reports; the free plan stays.
- Evidence: 210 users joined a waitlist for sync; 14 said in a survey they would pay.
- Channels: in-app messages and an email list of 2,800.
- Team: one founder and one contract designer. Launch budget: 300.

brief: Plan the launch of Acme's team plan to mid-size accounting firms, with a first pilot customer live in eight weeks.
intake:
# Acme

Acme sells a document checklist tool to solo accountants.

- Today: 410 paying solo accountants at 25 per month.
- New: a team plan with shared checklists and client portals, 15 per seat, 5 seats minimum.
- Evidence: 3 firms of 10 to 40 staff asked for it; one agreed to a pilot.
- Sales: nobody sells full time; the founder does demos.
- Team: three people. Budget: 4,000 for the launch quarter.

brief: Plan the launch of Acme's mobile app version on both app stores, going live in five weeks.
intake:
# Acme

Acme runs a web tool that helps small cafes plan staff shifts.

- Customers: 260 cafes paying 29 per month, mostly owner-managed.
- New: a mobile app so staff can see and swap shifts; managers keep the web tool.
- Evidence: the top support request is shift swaps by phone; 70% of logins are already on phones.
- Channels: a monthly newsletter, a partner coffee supplier that reaches 1,500 cafes.
- Team: two developers and one founder who does marketing. Budget: 2,500.

brief: Acme wants to raise its price for new customers from 19 to 29 per month next quarter. Decide whether to do it, for whom, and how to roll it out.
intake:
# Acme

Acme makes a web app that sends polite payment reminders for unpaid invoices.

- Customers: 210 paying agencies, 2 to 15 people each, on one plan at 19 per month.
- Churn: 3 percent a month; most who leave say they invoice too rarely to need it.
- Rivals: two tools at 25 and 39 per month, both with more integrations.
- Team: one founder, one developer, one part-time marketer. No sales team.

brief: Acme can afford one full-time hire in the next two months. Pick the role, write what it owns in its first 90 days, and plan the hiring steps.
intake:
# Acme

Acme sells scheduling software to independent physiotherapy clinics.

- Customers: 140 paying clinics; revenue 9,800 per month, growing 4 percent a month.
- Team: two founders (one product and code, one sales and support) and a contract designer.
- Pain: support takes the sales founder 15 hours a week; three demos a week go unbooked.
- Budget: up to 4,500 per month for the hire, all in.

brief: Acme must pick a transactional email provider to replace its current one within six weeks. Compare options and recommend one with a switch plan.
intake:
# Acme

Acme sends about 60,000 transactional emails a month (reminders, receipts, sign-in links).

- Problem: 4 percent of reminders land in spam since last month; two customers complained.
- Stack: a Python web app on one cloud server; emails are sent from a queue worker.
- Budget: up to 150 per month for email.
- Team: one developer who can spend about two days on the switch.
